name: Fun City Foods, Inc.
old_description: Back by popular demand, we’ve decided to rush our player's choice card cookies back into production. Within each bag is a whole deck of... cookies. Delicious, sweet, shortbread cookies. Available only at Fun City, we’re proud to get these back in.
about:
Fun City Foods, Inc. operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, where it runs a food distribution and equipment service business. The company does not disclose a founding year, but its president, Lon Ross, is the named leader and public face of the organization. The business presents itself as a supplier that serves customers of any size, emphasizing a nationwide reach backed by local availability.

The company functions as a master food service distributor for major brands including Mars, Hershey, and Nestlé. Its product lineup spans popcorn, candy, snacks, beverages, and an exclusive item called Player's Choice Card Cookies — shortbread cookies packaged as a full deck and sold only through Fun City. In addition to food distribution, the firm offers equipment sales and service, though specific machinery lines are not detailed. No facility size, headcount, or volume metrics are provided.

Fun City Foods targets the food service sector broadly, citing restaurants, convenience stores, hospitality operators, and retail outlets as typical customers. The company's messaging — "Big or small, we serve everyone!" — indicates a willingness to handle orders across a wide range of account sizes. Concrete end-user examples are not named in the source material.

The firm's stated differentiator is a business model built on the principle of never saying no, a philosophy attributed directly to President Lon Ross. This service-first stance is positioned as the core reason the company exists and the lens through which it approaches customer requests.
